verdict.rationale: There's a prebuilt Docker image published to GitHub Container Registry bundling headless Chrome, LibreOffice, and CJK fonts for self-hosted deployment, confirming Docker-based production deployment is supported. However missing for 10: no evidence of production deployment guidance (scaling, health checks, environment configuration), no independent hands-on report confirming the Docker image works reliably in production, and community evidence shows only hosted-API auth errors rather than self-hosted validation.
